title: Container vector partitions land on the pod overlay: no env override for vectors dir, image misses XDG_STATE_HOME
wanted_capability: The vector store root should honor the containerized-state contract: either derive from BLACKBOX_STATE_DIR when set, offer a dedicated env override (e.g. BLACKBOX_VECTORS_DIR), or the image should set XDG_STATE_HOME to the PVC. bbox-vectors default_vectors_dir() resolves dirs::state_dir() ($XDG_STATE_HOME or $HOME/.local/state), and vectors::global() opens it unconditionally (src/server/open.rs open_unloaded + lib.rs global()), so in the deploy/docker image (which sets HOME and BLACKBOX_STATE_DIR but not XDG_STATE_HOME) every pod roll silently discards all voyage partitions and re-buys the full embed backfill. Same footgun class as TRANSCRIPT_SEARCH_INDEX_PATH (fixed in f9bfbe9e); the Dockerfile comment "point every store env at it" claims coverage the vectors dir does not have.
fallback_used: Pinned XDG_STATE_HOME=/var/lib/blackbox/state/xdg-state (and the blackopsd twin) in the bbox-cage pulumi stack env, observed vectors materialize on the PVC, re-fired bbox_reembed(route=transcripts, include_transcripts=true).
evidence: thread-d2eee1c0 (cage: 19224 -> 4120 active vectors on pod rollout 2026-07-17)
